hypothesis: A composite electrode combining LiCoO2 and graphite will exhibit higher lithium intercalation capacity than either material alone
prediction: The composite electrode will have a lithium intercalation capacity 1.8 times that of pure graphite
measurement_method: Compare lithium intercalation capacity of pure graphite electrode vs. LiCoO2-graphite composite electrode using identical non-aqueous electrolyte and charge/discharge cycles
falsification_condition: If the composite electrode capacity is less than or equal to graphite capacity (ratio ≤ 1.0)
